sentences.text: We have heard the learned Counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner no.1 is the husband and the petitioner no.2 is the married sister-in-law of the victim.
It appears that over matrimonial dispute an incident took place in which it is alleged that the petitioner no.1 has assaulted the victim.

3. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the nature and extent of complicity of the petitioners in the commission of alleged offence and the nature of injury which appears to be simple,
we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the present petitioners is not necessary.

4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners, namely, Sailendra Paswan @

1 released on bail Signed By :
SANJIB GHOSH High Court of Calcutta 12 th of September 2024 11:20:39 AM upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each with two registered sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 corresponding to Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.
The petitioner nos. 1 shall meet the I.O. once in a week and the petitioner no.2 shall cooperate with the investigation till the submission of the final report.
The petitioners shall appear before the learned Trial Court within two weeks from date.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed.
6. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Prasenjit Biswas, J.)
